in_arabic.name: غضف
in_arabic.long_meaning: The name Ghadif is derived from the Arabic word 'ghadfa', which means 'to protect' or 'to shield'. This name is mentioned in a hadith in Sahih Muslim (Book 4, Hadith 2510) as the name of a companion of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh).
